title: Evidence Passport: offline MVP that turns one experiment-run manifest into a static HTML evidence passport and normalized JSON
description:
Evidence Passport is an offline, Python-standard-library MVP that validates one experiment-run manifest and writes a static HTML evidence passport plus normalized JSON. It records declared project, dataset, code, protocol, seed, baseline, metric, limitation, and artifact details. It does not generate data, score signals, or combine metrics.

Hash honesty. A matching SHA-256 shows only that a referenced local file is byte-for-byte consistent with the digest recorded in the bundle. It does not prove authorship, lock time, provenance authenticity, or measurement validity.

Bundled examples. An OES-Resilience NASA SMAP/MSL public-dataset passport preserves the upstream finding that the preregistered success criterion was not met. Three further examples are labelled SYNTHETIC (Multi-Quantum OES, Digital-to-Wave Testbench, Signal Test Commons).

Limits. Local metadata-and-reporting MVP only: not a validation authority, experiment runner, clinical device, hardware product, or provenance service. No NASA-beat claim.
notes: Bundled SMAP/MSL example: criterion not met. Synthetic examples labelled SYNTHETIC. Commercial licensing: see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md. Do not mint a GitHub release until the Zenodo webhook is enabled.
